notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.0 - Elves!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch [b]adds[/b] the following:[/u]
- Two new areas: Elven Capital and Elven Castle. (Available after Breaking the Empire at least once!)
- Three new enemy units + Two new bosses.
- 10 new achievements related to the new enemies and areas.
- Hold button to move (default will be a side button on the mouse).
- You can now change the cursor sensitivity when playing with a gamepad.

[u]This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:[/u]
- You can now [i]rebind[/i] the default mouse buttons, and also rebind other keys to the cursor. (If you experience any issues or find some weird bugs related to this, please let me know!)
- It's now easier to see the marked tile when trying to spawn blood elementals with Nosferella.
- The screen shakes when the player is struck, adding some more juicy-danger-danger-feel.
- End-screen does not display unavailable enemies: If you didn't play through Dwarf Mines, you will not need to see that you slayed 0 dwarf miners.

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]
- If breaking the empire with Nosferella first, her legacy perk will [i]NOT [/i]be missing.
- The player should not be able to spawn inside buildings while playing 'Last Stand'.
- Damage related achievements are checked with all spells. (Previously 'circle spells' like Nosferella and Burnie has), didn't register.
- You can start the game/go next by pressing spacebar after selecting New Game. 
- If empire dogs return as spirit animals (Drunh'Ko passive skill) they will fight for the player.

That is it for now. As always: [i]let me know ASAP if this causes anything unforseen[/i]!

A billion thanks for all the support, feedback and bug-reporting! It means the world to me! <3

If you like this game: [u][b]please leave a review and spread the word[/b][/u]!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.0 - Nosferella arrives!
notes.notes:

- Nosferella! A brand new character, a vampire, with 6 new active skills and 6 new passive skills.
- 5 more achievements!
- One more legacy perk, which will be unlocked when breaking the empire with Nosferella.
- A new target setting: attack furthest.

[u]This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:[/u]
- When cursor aiming, the exact area and spot will be better highlighted. 
- The base code for tile-related functions has been improved for better overall performance!
- Allies move around less, if close to the player.
- Dogs have less psychic armour.
- Color in certain menus are now clearer.
- Split up the new game menu into two seperate pages, to avoid overwhelming players with info and make the game more readable in lower resolutions.
- Improved Graethal's zombies and skeleton archers. They level up better. so to speak.
- A little flashier victory screen.

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]
- Show what will increase on first spell slot as well, if the player has one or more active skillpoints.

That is it for now! As always: should this patch cause anything unforseen - let me know ASAP! I am ready for hotfixing!

A billion thanks for all the love, support, feedback and bug reports! It means the world to me! =)

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

[i]EDIT: Made two fixes and uploaded them under this version: Nosferella could get stuck if dashing off screen, and one achievement didn't trigger when it should have. Thanks for reporting![/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.8.0.0 - Epic boss, balances and demon hunters!
notes.notes:
Before all details: [i]After playing this latest version - do you think the game is ready for 1.0? Is it worth the 5 dollars? Stable and balanced enough? Let me know! (To be perfectly clear: there will still be more content added after 1.0, but is this game ready to leave Early Access?) [/i]

[u]This patch [b]adds[/b] the following:[/u]
- A new challenging enemy in 'Last Stand': Demon hunters! They come in four different versions: explosive damage, acid, sharp, or ice!
- An epic, ultimate boss which appears after 20 minutes in 'Last Stand'.
- 5 new achievements!
- Acid tiles, damage and status effects related to this. (Acid lowers armor for 20 seconds)
- A new soundtrack called 'Tread Carefully'.
- Added a magic-melee sound effect, much more suitable.
- Added the new assets as main menu background.

[u]This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:[/u]
- [b]Spells will auto-attack cursor-selected buildings. Minions as well, if no other target nearby. [/b]
- Holy mothers can only raise a maximum of five units at once.
- 'Last Stand' mode has been greatly balanced.
- Drunh'Kos 'Buzzed bees' greatly improved.
- Castle looks prettier, furniture and statues spawn much more orderly.
- Elementals count as 'minions gathered' as well.
- Added kills + minion stats to default UI, at the bottom of player stats.
- Hovering with cursor over spells will automatically show that descriptions + stats.
- Greatly increases Graethal's poison immunity.
- Balanced/lowered the extra spell cost for many items.
- Craiga's movement spell now gets wider area with each rank but no longer strikes the same unit multiple times.
- Reactions will not 'ripple' as far, attracting less new hostiles.
- Critical- and damage perks are now correctly applied to skeleton shards.
- Improved enemy AI if ranged and behind wall.
- Ground fire damage increased from 3 to 5.
- General boss moves faster.
- Burnies dash is balanced and improved, same with Blizzie's movement spell, and Graethals.
- 'Internal combustion' meta perk fires are greated more tightly together.
- Burnie now starts with 50% armor to explosive damage.
- Halfling mayors are added to 'Last Stand'.
- Items which give health or mana from kills, give twice as much as before making them more useful!
- Blunt damage affects attack speed much less, so it's no longer possible completely stun enemies in melee.
- Holy beings (healers) will heal slightly less. (From 12.5% of max health down to 10%, but never more than 100 hit points.)

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]
- Fixed an issue in which corrupted save files would cause the game to crash on start.
- Legacy perks are now saved correctly!
- Craiga's meta perk no longer blinking constantly at times.
- Cain's mobility spell cuts mana regen in half, as it should.
- Highlights targeted buildings correctly.
- Craiga's moon shards no longer hurts friendly units.
- First controls option was aligned wrong. No longer!
- Wellforge ingame spawning looks better, pillar no longer floats over pits.
- Conversion bar on bosses adjusted.
- Removed one rather jarring sharp-dmg-vs-building sound effect.
- Linked spells menu no longer goes off screen.
- Legacy items in the main menu will not go off-screen if too many; instead, they align themselves in rows.
- Fix a weird camera jank when clicking the right controller.
- Fixed an issue which if you switched area while slowed, and then remained slowed forever.
- Fixes wild-repeated stone fists facing the wrong direction.
- Improved several sound effects.
- Fixed issue when using escape to leave sub menus and projectiles started moving.

I think that is it for now. As always: [i]let me know if this patch causes anything unforeseen and I will fix it ASAP[/i]!

A billion thanks for all the support, feedback and bug reports! <3
[i][b]Please share this game with your friends and leave a review![/b][/i]

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

EDIT: Made a few more fixes under this version number: two crashes less, Cain's healing spell balanced (not as hefty increase per level), and wild repeats are not totally random but instead follow the previous projectiles general direction.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.5.0 - More meta progression + Controller support!
notes.notes:
First of all: This patch does add controller support, but since I am not much of a controller player myself, [i]please give me feedback[/i]!

Now on to the usual:
[u]This patch adds the following:[/u]
- Unlockable meta-progression perks, one rewarded by breaking the empire with each character. However, any character can choose these when starting a new game. They will be very varied and can alter the gameplay a lot!
- As mentioned above: Controller support!

[u]This patch changes/balances the following:[/u]
- 'Last stand' now requires that you first break the empire with that character.
- Greatly balances a few spells and perks, most noticeably: Craiga's stone elemental and moon shards, Graethal's venom breath, Blizzie's ice on impact, and Burnie's healing when standing in fire.
- It's now much easier to spot the castle entrance through the map.
- Ensures all attacks have a crit chance. This includes movement spells, circle spells and a few more which previously could never crit.
- Push-damage against terrain has been doubled.
- Buildings will create less rubble when destroyed.

[u]This patch fixes the following:[/u]
- Corrected the reminder popup.
- UI can no longer be hidden in main menu.
- Wraiths now have correct idle animation.
- When changing resolutions, menus should not disappear off-screen sometimes.
- Maybe less rubble from buildings.

That is it for now! Many balances remain and with the new perks, more will probably be needed. 

As always: If this causes any new issues: let me know ASAP so I can fix it right away!

And finally: A billion thanks for all the feedback and support! Remember to leave a review to help this game grow!

Best wishes and all the love! <3
//Mattias

EDIT: Uploaded a new version under this version-number. It fixes an issue in which the game got stuck at an unclosable menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1.0 - A few balances and fixes!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch does the following:[/u]
- Militias nerfed! Their member-amount has been cut in half, which hopefully offers a challenge while not being overwhelming.
- No health regen when stuck inside blocks (like mountains) or while drowning. The health lost will also be percentage based. Previously, with enough hp-regen, the player could "drown" forever.
- It is now easier to notice when minions can't be spawned due to minion limit. The icon will turn red and shake a little.
- The tutorial has been slightly improved and information about meta-progression through achievements has been added.
- Explosion in water close the map edged caused some glitchy auto-tiling. No more!
EDIT: Made a fix so  player minions are counted correctly in Last Stand mode.

As always: a ton of thanks for the feedback, [i]keep it coming[/i]!  Remember: [u]this is early access because I need your help[/u]!

If you like this game: [b]please leave a review[/b]!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.7.0.0 - Last stand! (New game mode + major balances)
notes.notes:
[i]I am looking for feedback - so please don't miss the final paragraph![/i]

[u]This patch [b]adds[/b] the following:[/u]
- A new game mode, '[i][b]Last Stand[/b][/i]', with 4 unlockable achievements. (A very difficult game mode!)
- In campaign (the default game mode), you can now encounter militias - a small horde/army attacking you. +1 new achievement related to this.

[u]This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:[/u]
- [b]Mana regen and HP regen are now percentage-based[/b], greatly balancing the game and deepening the choice between a bigger pool (which now also increases the percentage-based regen) and increasing the percentage itself.
-You can now equip and unequip items when interacting with in-game wellforges, making the experience much smoother.
- Cobble and street tiles now have added particle effects when destroyed.
- Dogs have slightly less psychic resistance.
- Graethal's 'Sharp Bones' perk is greatly improved.
- Many balance changes to Craiga—more starting HP and longer range. There was an issue with the 'Rock Solid' perk, where fists passing through enemies rarely hit another one. That perk has also been improved. Her base spell also travels faster and is slightly cheaper.
- Stone rubble and rocks have had their contrast increased, so they should be much more noticeable.

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]
- Fire elementals no longer get stuck randomly.
- Clicking menus now properly pauses and unpauses the game.
- Friendly ranged units now properly use ranged attacks against buildings.
- All dead units now draw beneath the living.
- It no longer incorrectly states that stone elementals cause fire damage.
- Graethal's 'Wraith' spell now costs mana as intended.
- Wraiths now fade more smoothly—no more ugly transitions.
- Flyers have had their shadows adjusted for a better, more natural look.

As always, tons of thanks for your support, feedback, and bug reporting! It means the world to me! This game is finally getting more attention, which just warms my heart endlessly.

Last but not least: [u]I want feedback[/u]! My initial plan was that 'Last Stand' should be unlockable, requiring the player to first defeat the emperor first with selected character. What do you think of this? Some might want the option from the beginning, but the game mode is very difficult, so new players might be frustrated, wondering why they don't last longer. Anyways, please try it out and let me know what you think!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

EDIT: Local militia spawn chance was to low, so I fixed that and patched the game under the same version number.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.7.2 - Trees and buildings fade properly (again)
Patch 0.6.7.1 - Crash no more!
Patch 0.6.7.0 - Halflings and shadows!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch [b]adds [/b]the following:[/u]
- 5 new achievements!
- An alternative start to your quests: start by invading a peaceful halfling hamlet! Comes with new enemies and a new boss.
- Enemies can now have two new traits: '[i]sneaky[/i]' and '[i]holy[/i]'. Sneaky npcs are tinier, faster and deadlier, while holy npcs glow purple/red and heal those around them.
- Each character's base stats are now visible when choosing characters.
- Smoother area to area transitions with a little text.

[u]This patch [b]changes [/b]the following:[/u]
- Shadows look a lot better and their direction will vary throughout campaigns.
- Water looks better and is more colorful.
- When hit, the player flashes white briefly as well, highlighting damage.
- Damage pop-ups are briefer but can last longer when the damage is high.
- Legacy items will more clearly indicate that they are brought along.
- Cain's paralyzing gaze no longer works on towers. It also increases by 2% per rank instead of 1, but freezes for 3 seconds instead of 4.
- Craiga has a longer and a little better death animation.
- In-game Wellforges give items directly into the inventory, so no need to unpause to see the new item, etc.
- New items flash once when the inventory opens.
- Improved road generation.
- Craiga's intro scream was still too jarring, so it has been softened.

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]

- Gets rid of crash which occured when right clicking on an empty storage slot when using a Wellforge.

That is it for now. As always: should this patch cause anything unforseen - let me know asap! I am very ready for a hot-fix!

A billion thanks for all the feedback and support!
Finally: please [u][b]leave a review [/b][/u]and [u][b]recommened this game [/b][/u]to a friend or two!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.6.5.0 - Gameplay improved, balanced and enriched!
notes.notes:
[b]This patch adds the following:[/b]
- Enemies can now drop Health- and Mana potions.
- Wellforges can now be found in-game.
- Two new item effects: increased damage for a specific damage class, and gain mana/HP on kill. 
- Adds one new song to the OST.

[b]This patch changes the following:[/b]
- Many of the base attack spells were horribly unbalanced - actually becoming more costly (damage/mana) per rank. They have now been balanced, and the damage/mana will increase when leveling up. (Big thanks to ShellBeachHun for pointing out this mistake !)
- Attack spells now have additional info in the spellmenu: Damage/Mana.
- Mana and Hp are maxed when switching area. Any negative effects are removed as well.
- Finding 'fun and easy-to-use' items is now less rare.
- Many other spells have been balanced as well.
- The universal skills which adds mana and health now adds much more, making them more of a valid choice.
- The universal skill for critical hit is now much better. Crit chance starts at 3% and is improved by +3% each rank.

[b]Minor fixes:[/b]
- Got rid of overlapping text in Satyrs spell menu.
- Added more variety to the UI-map: different colors for different buildings, etc.
- Destroying a non-empty building will spawn wounded units.
- Added a missing sound effect for when fire elementals die.
- Easier to pickup stuff. (Items move faster towards the player and requires less distance to be picked up)
- Corpse explosion on Ol' Stumpy doesn't result in immovable tiles.
- Graethal warp landing has nicer and softer sound effect.

I think these improvements greatly increase the pace and feeling of the game. Let me know what you think! And as always: a billions thanks for the feedback and support! Should this patch cause something unforseen: let me know!

[u][b]If you like this game: share it with your friends and leave a review![/b][/u]

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.6.3.3 - Important fix for Graethal!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.3.2 - One crash less!
Patch 0.6.3.0 - Drunh'Ko the Satyr!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! Happy new year! All that jazz!!

[b]Here is what this patch adds:[/b]
- A new character: [b]Drunh'Ko the Saty[/b]r! So that's another six spells and six passives for you! He will [u][b]make flowers bloom and blood be spilled[/b][/u]! I think he is really fun to play, so please try him out!
- 5 more Steam achievements!

[b]Here is what this patch fixes:[/b]
- Added missing effects to the Wellforge.
- Adjusted minion behavior to avoid attacking targets that are too far away.
- Damage numbers for melee and ranged attacks are now color-coded to show what the damage class is (in the unit-info panel).
- Fixed an issue where auto-spawning minions bypassed their cost.
- Improved lighting effects for beings, making them visually consistent, following targets, etc.
- Cain's healing sound no longer stacks excessively.
- Updated the Necroblast hit sound effect.
- Graethals passive skill that raises wraiths, are no longer limited by the maximum minion count. Its base chance per rank is now 3% instead of 2,5 and Wraith also fly, so they can cross water, etc.
- Wraith skill now scales 3% per rank (up from 2.5%) and uses the flyers' grid.
- Expanded attack settings for Burnies' Fire Rain ability.
- Enhanced movement of XP pop-ups for better readability. (They move closer to the player at a more consistent pace, hopefully!)
- Fixed missing outlines on beings when loading saved games.
- Resolved an issue where Craiga could get stuck and take terrain damage after exiting a dash.
- Craiga is now called 'the Geomancer', instead of Stonemancer.
- Casting tile-creation items is now less spell-costly.
- Fixed two memory leaks that caused stuttering during extended gameplay sessions.

That is it for now. I really wanted something new for you guys before Christmas, so I hope you enjoy this patch! As always: [b]should this cause anything unforseen, let me know - I will try to fix it ASAP![/b]

The game is picking up some speed, which is great, so big thanks for spreading the word! [u][i][b]Please leave a review[/b] if you like this game - it really helps![/i][/u]

Best wishes and lots of love and happy holidays! <3 <3 <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1.0 - More improvements, fixes and polish!
notes.notes:
This patch [b]adds[/b] the following:
- Neat sprite effects to explosions and certain spells, adding more game juice!
- The player's journey and progress are now shown when the game is paused.

This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:
- Empire units will get increased reaction distance the more they react to nearby or direct attacks.
- Converted dwarven miners will do great damage against buildings. (They have pickaxes, after all.)
- Non-bosses' psychic armor will be clamped at 97.5%, so you can always convert them.
- Graethal's passive skill 'Chain Reaction' now works as it should, making it an incredibly powerful tool when used properly. (Really, try it!)

This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:
- Blunt damage pop-ups on buildings are now centered.
- Graethal teleport spell blocks movement input, so you actually land where you aim.
- Converted dwarven miners will not start mining randomly.
- Hair and beard sprite were off on heroic and giant dwarves when dead.
- Archmage-boss had a "dev guide pixel," which I had forgotten to remove.
- I also added a "previous_stable" version, available as a Beta version, just in case!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.6.0.0 - Content, fixes and improvements!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch [b]adds[/b] the following:[/u]
- Two new areas: Glades and Dwarven Mines!
- Four new enemies! (with some variation in each)
- Two new bosses!
- Five new achievements!
- When low on health, the edges of the screen will indicate this with ultra-cool blood effects.
- Units (including the player) are now outlined, (The opacity of the outlines can be adjusted)
- Adds two new settings to summon spells: auto-spawn on player, or at cursor.
- A new type of item effect: 'Wild Repeats x1-6'. A projectile will spawn a new version of itself when hitting something.
- More detailed and interesting shadows!

[u]This patch [b]fixes[/b] the following:[/u]
- Impropved castle enemy spawning. Enemies should no longer spawn next to the player at start.
- Improved overall performance.
- Improved the way trees and buildings fade when the player is near.
- Fixes a freeze crash occuring when sometimes using movement spells.
- Removes a bug where the player couldn't enter the castle.
- A weird bug where unpausing would cause meteor spells to move sideways.
- Craigas intro-scream is less jarring and startling.

[u]This patch [b]changes[/b] the following:[/u]
- Giant units' projectiles are now also bigger.
- The game zooms in when the player is dying.
- Health bars and names are now drawn over everything, making the screen less messy.
- The player can now move-push mountain tiles as well. Push damage is also increased.
- Balanced Cains heal-minions passive. (It was way OP)
- Cains weakness spell now applies to ranged damage as well.
- Sharp damage color is now more distinct from healing color.
- Holy Mother special attack animation has been improved.
- Craigas mana-regen-passive is increased from 1 to 1.5, per rank.

I think that is it for now. [b]If this patch causes any issues:[u] let me know ASAP and I will fix it![/u][/b]
If you like this game:

[i][u][b]Please give it a positive review and share it with your friends![/b][/u][/i]

And, as always: A billion thanks for all the feedback and support!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.5.6.1 - One important fix and some improvements!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch does the following:[/u]
- Skills health bonus is properly applied to summons now.
- Blunt damage no longer messes up units ranged attack. They would often 'skip' actually launch the projectile.
- Units knockpower balanced.
- Projectiles play a sound effect when hitting the ground.
- Area damage will not occasionally clear paths through existing buildings.

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.5.6.0 - Craiga the Stonemancer!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch [b]adds [/b]the following:[/u]
- A brand new character: [b]Craiga the Stonemancer. [/b] So check out her six new spells and six new passives!
- 5 new achievements!

[u]This patch [b]changes [/b]the following:[/u]
- Changed the XP-tick-sound for a better and creamier one. Also added an option to turn off that sound effect altogether.
- Targeting and area symbols are now slightly outlined, making them easier to read.
- Balanced sound effects for terrain destruction. (Limited the number of effects played at once)
- Drowning only happens in deeper water, not at the edges.
- FPS now shown in menus too, when toggled ON.
- Burnie's leap now counts as AOE and scales with the base spec.
- 'Field of Mayhem' now costs less mana, and 'Berserk' effects lasts the right duration. (Also makes sure the sound effect is only played once, since it could stack way too much in certain cases.)
- Improved sound and added a small effect for skill increases.
- Graethal's 'Necroblast' now deals blunt damage to buildings, instead of 0 poison damage.
- Units resurrected by Holy Mother, will not lose their weapon sprite + have a nice 'reverse dying'-animation.

[u]This patch [b]fixes [/b]the following:[/u]
- There will not be invisible "walls" in the castle, causing the player to not launch spells sometimes.
- The base-skill increasing area no longer affects summons health.
- 'Blizzard' now aims correctly when auto-attacking!
- Grass particle effects appearing in water – gone for good!
- Fixed spell aiming so they don't "bounce" away when missing their target. (At least not nearly as often)
- It is much easier to knock enemies into water to drown them.
- Fixed invisible solid objects in the castle.
- Improved the sound- and visual effects for gaining mana/health through items or skills.
- Improved detection for ground ice and fires.
- Adjusted item depth for better layering.
- Pause menu now remembers animation speed, so certain animations no longer stay frozen when unpausing.
- Cain’s conversion ability now bypasses defense more effectively. (There psychic-defense check was done twice (not intended), so that was the reason why it was almost impossible to certain units.)
- There should no longer be trees which anyone can pass straight through.

I think that was it for this patch. I really enjoy playing this character so please try her out! As always: a billion thanks for the feedback, bug-reports and general support! [i]If you experience any issues: let me know ASAP and I will hotfix the game![/i]

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

[i]PS: If you like this game: [b]please [/b]share it with your friends and/or leave a review!
[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.5.6 - One less jarring sound!
Patch 0.5.5.5 - 'Save n' Push'
notes.notes:
[u]This patch does the following:[/u]
- Adds [b]Save/Continue game[/b] functions! You can now save-and-exit to continue your game later.
- [b]Terrain-push-destruction[/b]! Walking into minor terrain like logs, boulders or furniture can now be used to break it and clear a path.
- New soundtrack! Added a new song to the soundtrack.
- When aiming directly with the cursor, it should communicate clearer if the spell is not ready and/or not-enough-mana. 
- Units stuck in terrain should automatically 'unstuck' themselves.
- The titles of songs can now be read in the main pause menu.

[u]The following fixes have been made:[/u]
- Terrain destruction now works properly, no more invisible blocked cells.
- Adjusting the volume via scrolling now correctly also saves the setting.
- Self-inflicted damage is now better recognized.
- Spawning and Ice block on top of Blizzie counts as self-inflicted instead of terrain damage.
- Fixed a crash related to spawning ice blocks + a freeze related to the same.
- Fixed another crash related to starting a new game after dying.
- Blizzie's Ice Blocks can no longer bleed.
- Levelling up no longer aborts Blizzie's hail spell.
- Blizzie's move-spell aiming has been corrected.
- Cursor no longer sometimes stay red when returning to the main menu.
- Projectiles no longer freeze mid air when opening multiple menus.
- Converted archers no longer fire their special arrow if no enemies are nearby.
- Corrected ugly background scaling in windowed mode for the 'New Game' page.
- Drawing depth of dead units has been fixed.

[u]The following adjustments/balancing has been made:[/u]
- Spell Toggle Improvements: You can now always turn off spells like Hail and Levitate.
- Elemental/Inanimate armor has been balances/fixed and all are now immune to poison- and psychic damage.
- Players mass has been tweaked and fixed. (Burnie weight a little less than the rest, etc)

As always: should this cause anything unforseen: Let me know ASAP and I will do a hot fix! Thanks a bunch for all the feedback, support and bugreporting! If you like this game: [b][i]please leave a positive review and maybe even recommend it to your friends[/i][/b]! <3

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 0.5.5.0 - Animations!
notes.notes:
[u]This patch does the following:[/u]
- [u][b]ANIMATION![/b][/u] All beings are now animated. [b]The game will hopefully look and feel [i]a lot better![/i][/b]
- 5 new achievements!
- Damage-number pop-ups now spawn [i]above [/i]the relevant target, making the game easier to read.
- Some sound effects and UI-sounds have been improved and balanced.
- Fire elementals no longer bleed.
- Adds particles effects to destroying grass.
- Improves and balances one of the soundtracks.
- When clicking escape to remove new-game-info-popups, they will no longer instantly return, which was annoying.
- Removes a crash related to dying from fire damage.

While this patch does not provide much new content, I really hope it improves the feeling of the game. I will create a new trailer and update the Steam page soon, to hopefully attract more players! And, I must say, wow... animations really made a huge difference! I really thought a simple game like this would work equally well with pawn movement, but I was very wrong about that!

As always: A big thanks for all the feedback, bug reports and support! A huge thanks to all new players who dare to purchase this unknown and new game! This means the world to me!

Also: If this patch causes anything unforseen: Let me know ASAP and I will upload a hot fix!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

PS: A save function will be added soon! (I have not forgotten this!)

notes.title: Patch 0.5.4.0 - Blizzie McIcer! (Ice-cold!)
notes.notes:
[u]This patch does the following:[/u]
- A brand new playable character: [u][b]ice mage Blizzie McIcer[/b][/u]! She comes with 6 new active spells and 6 new passive skills as well as a brand new damage type: Ice.
- 5 new achievements!
- Achievements now give a bonus when starting a new game. (5 achivements converts to 1 universal skill point)
- Improved a few base game functions, making the game less prone to lag and smoother in general. To mention some things: better collisions checks for projectiles, the players projectiles also checks for collision so you don't waste mana, beings will move away from fire and ice-tiles, etc.
- Made shadows much more visible, hopefully making the game easier to read.
- Updated some of the graphics, most notably grass.
- Buildings now yield XP when destroyed.
- The Archmages circle-attack is now psynched, so you will actually be safe outside the shown area.
- When using move-skills with Burnie and Graethal, you are now 'phased' and can't take damage.
- Beings can now drown as well.
- Some overall balancing of spells.
- No more invisible blocked tiles after destroying buildings.
- The looks of empire units (skin- and hair color) now changes between each map instead of only when you restart the game, which was a bug.
- Many more minor fixes and bug-removals!

As always: A billion thanks for the feedback, support and bug-reports! I really wanted to add a save-game-function with this patch, but that will be added with the next bigger patch! And if this patches causes something unforseen: [u]let me know and I will fix it ASAP[/u].

One last thing: Please let me know how Blizzie works! I really like ice-magic myself so I very much hope you enjoy her!

Best wishes and lots of love! <3
//Mattias

PS: [i]This game's release went very unnoticed, which was a bit of a downer. If you like this game: Please review it, spread the word and maybe tell your friends? <3[/i]
